veggies.name: Tomato
veggies.desc: Firm, ripe tomatoes from this morning's lot. Good for gravies, chutneys and the lunchbox salad.

veggies.name: Onion
veggies.desc: Dry, clean bulbs with the tops trimmed short. Keeps well for weeks in a cool, dark pantry.

veggies.name: Potato
veggies.desc: Firm potatoes brushed clean, no green patches. Boils dry for fries, holds shape in sambar.

veggies.name: Green Chilli
veggies.desc: Thin, sharp chillies picked this morning. A little goes a long way in the tempering.

veggies.name: Brinjal
veggies.desc: Glossy, tight-skinned brinjals — best when the skin springs back at a press.

veggies.name: Cucumber
veggies.desc: Cool, watery cucumbers for pachadi, raita and the salad box. Sold by weight.

veggies.name: Capsicum
veggies.desc: Crunchy green capsicum with thick walls. Slices clean for stir-fries and biryani.

veggies.name: Spinach
veggies.desc: A fresh bunch of palak with the roots trimmed. Goes soft quickly in a hot pan.

veggies.name: Cabbage
veggies.desc: Tight, heavy heads that feel solid in the hand. Crisp for poriyal, soft for a slow curry.

veggies.name: Coriander
veggies.desc: Fragrant coriander bunches, stems on. Wash, dry and chill to keep the leaves perky.

veggies.name: Green Mango
veggies.desc: Hard green mangoes for pachadi, pickle and the salt-and-chilli snack.

veggies.name: Carrot
veggies.desc: Snappy carrots with a bright core. Sweet enough to eat raw, firm enough to grate.

veggies.name: Beetroot
veggies.desc: Deep-red beetroots with clean rings. Roast or boil — the skin slips right off.

veggies.name: Garlic
veggies.desc: Plump, dry bulbs sold by weight so you get exactly the pods you need.

veggies.name: Ginger
veggies.desc: Fresh ginger with a juicy snap. Grate it for chai, slice it for the tempering.

veggies.name: Broccoli
veggies.desc: Tight green florets, cut to order at the counter. Steam three minutes, no more.

veggies.name: Drumstick
veggies.desc: Long drumsticks with fat seeds inside — the classic sambar stick.

veggies.name: Mushroom
veggies.desc: Button mushrooms in clean, dry trays. Ready for the masala, no washing needed.
